svg.title: Backpropagation through a tiny graph
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Backpropagation through a tiny graph” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A five-node computation graph drawn left to right in blue for the forward pass with the intermediate values written above each node, and long green arrows running right to left underneath carrying the partial derivatives, ending in a weight update that moves w from 3.0 to 2.2.
svg.text: draw it from memory, then compare
